scope: source-only audit and synthetic runtime preparation; the live full-pack process, its log, its output directory, MOP, and the sealed artifact were not inspected or touched

packer_output.layout: u64 JSON length, JSON index, shared basis payloads, tensor payloads

finding.gap: The running pack could finish successfully yet the documented next capability command could not open its artifact. No .aap assembler, source, or runtime consumer existed.
finding.additional_abi_defect: Pass-through .aap index entries omitted their source dtype. The official source contains both BF16 and F32 tensors, so 2-byte-versus-4-byte payload size is insufficient as a complete self-description.

implemented.oracle_support: tools/condense/glm52_flagship_oracle.py auto-detects exactly one Gravity or activation-aware model index
implemented.integrity: assembly hashes each original .aap shard and binds those hashes into model.activation_aware.index.json; verified runtime rejects a mismatch
implemented.coverage: assembly grades names, source-shard placement, nonzero payloads, dispositions, and dtype availability against the pinned official tensor map
implemented.copy_policy: assembly leaves model-*.aap in place and creates no second model copy; pinned tokenizer assets are hardlinked when possible
implemented.dtype_recovery_for_already_running_proce: MEASUREMENT.json is authoritative for every source dtype because the already-running Python process cannot acquire a source edit after launch
implemented.dtype_self_description_for_future_proces: newly launched pack processes also write dtype into every .aap tensor index entry

proved: input-side factorized matvec equals reconstructed dense authority
output-side factorized matvec equals reconstructed dense authority
factorized row lookup equals reconstructed dense authority
BF16 pass-through decoding is exact on the fixture
official-map coverage fails on a tensor absent from the packer's own index
shard hash binds runtime bytes and rejects tampering
existing activation-aware byte accounting, provenance, floor, and determinism tests remain green

post_pack_handoff: Run glm52_activation_aware_assemble.py check against the completed directory.
Run glm52_activation_aware_assemble.py assemble only if coverage is COMPLETE; this computes shard hashes and installs the pinned tokenizer without duplicating model bytes.
Run glm52_capability_gate.py against that assembled directory, cheapest G_math first.
Do not emit an APPROVED capability record unless G_math and G_live both pass.

remaining_limit.rust_metal_runtime: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED for activation-aware payloads
remaining_limit.meaning: The numpy capability gate is now executable after assembly, but Rust/Metal parity, sustained speed, and sealed-runtime gates remain pending and unclaimed.
